rounds.title: Single active panel
rounds.interviewerPrompt: Implement deterministic tab selection without duplicating panel state.
constraints: Start on Overview and render exactly one panel.
Selecting a tab updates both its active styling and the visible panel.
Repeatedly selecting the active tab is a no-op.

frameworkTests.name: Round 1 · One selected tab owns one panel

rounds.title: Keyboard and ARIA contract
rounds.interviewerPrompt: Upgrade the control to the WAI-ARIA tabs keyboard pattern.
constraints: Expose the tab container as tablist and each control as a tab.
Keep aria-selected, aria-controls, tab IDs, panel IDs, and aria-labelledby synchronized.
Use roving tabindex so only the selected tab is in the page tab order.
ArrowLeft and ArrowRight wrap focus and selection; Home and End select the first and last tabs.

frameworkTests.name: Round 2 · Arrow navigation updates selection and panel
